title: Weak Zariski Decompositions of Pseudo-Effective Divisors
exact_target: Let $D$ be a pseudo-effective relative real Cartier divisor on a normal variety $X/Z$. Must there exist a projective birational map $f:W\to X$ and a numerical decomposition $f^*D\equiv_Z P+N$ with $P$ nef over $Z$ and $N$ effective? Such a decomposition is called a weak Zariski decomposition.
